test_conditions: Synthetic polarization transients and before/after EIS for A/B at nominal 25 °C, 10 mV. Explicit resistance parameters match invented semicircle diameters; tLi+ is not an Isteady/Iinitial ratio.

reference.observation: Current polarization paired with before/after EIS; synthetic known parameters only.
reference.review_scope: Original PDF figure and caption visually checked; no numerical values or artwork copied

reproduce: python render_specialist.py --recipe transference --input-folder transference --output-dir brf-output --style forge
creator: BatteryReviewForge original synthetic analytic demonstration

equations: Z(omega)=Rs+R_interface/(1+j*omega*R_interface*C); before/after R_interface is R0 and Rss
assumptions: Binary-electrolyte Bruce–Vincent-style demonstration with the supplied interfacial resistances.
Semicircle diameter is R_interface; the separate Rs is not silently substituted for it.

references.title: Evans, Vincent and Bruce: electrochemical measurement of transference numbers
references.supports: Resistance-corrected polarization method and its assumptions; all numeric inputs are original.

references.title: Gamry: electrochemical impedance spectroscopy
references.supports: Ideal parallel-RC element and high/low-frequency resistance limits.

limitations: An apparent method-specific quantity, not a rigorous concentrated-solution transference measurement.
No EIS optimizer, concentration corrections, activity coefficients or measured electrode evolution.
scientific_basis.validation_scope: Declared teaching model and internal relationships only; no experimental or material certification.
